hypothesis: A quality company that also clears the cross-sectional free-cash-flow/assets rank should have more durable earnings quality than the R253 weakest link alone. The new factor takes the minimum of the R253 percentile and the FCF/assets percentile, preserving the weakest-link construction while adding a cash-generation requirement.
selection_basis: R253 passed both IC segments and most relative/full-sample gates but failed recent-year, 4x/5x cost and concentration gates. R246 free-cash-flow/assets had 100% coverage and positive validation and recent-year relative behavior, while its standalone strategy failed discovery and full-sample gates. R256 tests the economically distinct combination rather than tuning R253. The feasibility audit read no forward or strategy returns: R253/FCF joint coverage is 100% in full, discovery, validation and recent year; 42 month-end rank correlations average 0.303375 (range 0.090587 to 0.419795); the preview minimum factor differs from the R253 percentile by 0.130743 on average and is at least 0.10 lower for 35.80% of observations. Evidence: r256_data_feasibility.json.

factor.formula: cash_backed_quality_min_rank = min(rank_pct(management_ocf_gm_min_rank), rank_pct(free_cash_flow_assets)) within same-date historical nonfinancial HS300 members; 1 is best and 0 is worst
factor.interpretation: R253 remains the existing minimum of management-expense, OCF-margin and gross-margin-trend percentiles. R256 adds FCF/assets as a fourth weak link instead of changing R253 internals.
factor.pit_rule: R253 and FCF inherit their existing financial publication/PIT dates. Percentile ranks and the minimum use only same-date eligible historical nonfinancial HS300 members. No component is forward-filled beyond its own provider/PIT rule.
factor.missing_data_rule: Both components are required; a missing component leaves the composite null.

strategies.common_filter: Current nonfinancial industry snapshot is required; history uses historical HS300 membership. Both strategies require ma60 and non-null cash_backed_quality_min_rank, so the candidate/control universe and component availability are identical.
strategies.execution: 30-name score limit, at most 10 equal-weight positions, 20-day holding, -20% stop loss, T+1 open execution and 3x costs; candidate also tested at 4x/5x.

execution.cost_stress: 4x and 5x scale all four components proportionally

segments.stitching: compound two independently run segment curves; skip the first return of each later segment

factor_ic.method: R256 factor month-end rank IC versus T+1 open to T+21 open return within historical nonfinancial HS300 members

gates.D1: full and recent-12-month joint component coverage >=0.99
gates.D2: discovery and validation joint component coverage >=0.99
gates.D3: first valid date is no later than 2023-05-04 and written rows exactly match the same-date composite formula with max abs difference <=1e-12
gates.D4: mean absolute monthly component rank correlation <=0.70, every monthly correlation <=0.80, mean composite reduction versus R253 percentile >=0.05 and at least 20% of observations reduced by >=0.10
gates.I1: discovery mean R256 rank IC >=0.02 with at least 18 month-end observations
gates.I2: validation mean R256 rank IC >=0.01 with at least 18 month-end observations and the same positive sign
gates.G2: discovery candidate MDD is no worse than control MDD by more than 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample candidate return > 0 and >= control return
gates.G5: full-sample candidate MDD <= 40% in absolute value and no worse than control by more than 5pp
gates.G6: rolling 1-year positive rate >= 60% and no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G7: recent 12-month candidate return > 0 and MDD no worse than control by more than 5pp
gates.G8: full-sample candidate return at 4x cost is positive
gates.G9: full-sample candidate return at 5x cost is positive
gates.C1: at least 30 distinct symbols are traded across the full sample
gates.C2: the largest symbol's share of net P&L is <= 25%
gates.C3: the top three symbols' share of net P&L is <= 55%
gates.C4: the top five symbols' share of net P&L is <= 75%
gates.C5: at least 8 distinct symbols have positive P&L in the validation segment
gates.C6: the largest industry's share of gross profit is <= 45%
gates.C7: the largest single-symbol loss is <= 20% of gross profit in absolute value

decision_rule: All D, I, G and C gates must pass. Any failure means the cash-backed quality factor is not accepted and cannot be rescued by changing component weights, rank direction, holding period, stop loss, universe, costs or gates after seeing results.
known_limitations: The FCF component is annual and can be up to 500 days old; it may lag changing cash generation.
The minimum of four percentile ranks can be sparse and sensitive to ties.
R253 and R246 were already researched in overlapping samples, so multiple-comparison risk remains.
The nonfinancial industry snapshot is current rather than historical PIT.
Financial values inherit provider restatement and publication-timing risk.
The full curve is stitched from two system-engine segments and segment boundaries can reset open positions.
Passing these gates would justify paper-trading validation, not production deployment.
